caption: Cosa ruins on Ansedonia headland, Ansedonia
composition: Roman polygonal walls and temple podium on the Ansedonia ridge above turquoise Tyrrhenian water · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist looks along the Ansedonia headland where the polygonal walls of Cosa's ruins climb the rocky ridge, with the standing columns of a temple podium rising on the summit among dark cypresses. The turquoise Tyrrhenian fills the right, with a curving beach and a calm lagoon below the cliffs. The 14:15 sun is bright under a sky of thin high cloud, and the ancient stone glows golden against the blue water.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of Ansedonia under afternoon light
